## Hi, I’m Martinas Jucys Brady

Welcome to my ePortfolio!

I’m a fourth-year Business Studies International student at Dublin City University, specialising in Data Analytics and studying Japanese. Over the past few years, I’ve been exploring how business understanding, data-driven thinking, and global perspectives can come together to solve real problems and uncover meaningful insights.

This portfolio brings together work that reflects both my academic learning and personal growth; from data analysis projects and visualisations to research papers, reflections and creative presentations. Each piece represents a step in how I’ve learned to connect analytical skills with communication and cross-cultural awareness.

## What This Portfolio Represents

This portfolio is a snapshot of where I am now as a student and where I want to go next. It highlights the combination of skills that define my degree and my interests:

- Business understanding
- Analytical thinking
- Data visualisation
- International perspective
- Japanese language and intercultural learning

## Explore

Here you can browse selected academic work and personal experiences that showcase my development throughout university. Together, they tell the story of a student interested in not only understanding ideas, but also presenting them clearly, creatively, and with purpose.
